messages:
Jordan (People Ops): Just got married in Spain last week. Want to add my spouse to benefits. They only have a passport and our Spanish marriage cert (we're getting an English translation). Can I add dental and vision now and wait on medical until SSN/ITIN?
Sofia L.: Congrats! Yes, marriage is a QLE. Dental/vision carriers are usually fine with passport + translated marriage cert. Medical carriers typically want SSN or ITIN but we can submit pending-ssn paperwork.
Diego (Benefits): Docs needed: translated marriage cert, spouse passport, proof of residency preferred. If you enroll dental now, put "dental only" in subject. For medical later, we can submit with "SSN pending" and update when you have it.
Jordan (People Ops): Will premiums be prorated if I enroll mid-month?
PayrollBot: Yes. Deductions start after carrier confirms effective date and payroll prorates mid-period adds.
Diego (Benefits): HSA note: switching to family medical moves your IRS HSA limit to family for the calendar year; we'll update payroll contributions when medical becomes effective.
Jordan (People Ops): Secure upload?
Sofia L.: Use https://hr.redwood.com/secure-upload (internal). If emailing, send to benefits@redwood.com with "SECURE" and we'll respond with a transient upload link.
Jordan (People Ops): Thanks, uploading now.
Diego (Benefits): Expect carrier turnaround 7-14 business days after complete docs. We'll confirm effective date once submitted.
